<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from the scixplorer source. Do not edit: run `uv run python scripts/gen_docs.py`. -->

`Document` has 101 fields: 90 that can be returned and 11 that can only be searched. A plain `Document.select()` fetches every returnable field except the 7 deferred ones.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Field | the attribute: `Document.<field>` in a search, `doc.<field>` on a result |
| Solr name | the field's name in the Solr query, when it differs |
| Type | the Python type of a value; `list[...]` for a multi-valued field. A missing value is `None` |
| Match | how `==` matches: `keyword` (literally), `text` (words as a phrase, with synonyms), `name` (with name variants) |
| Notes | `search-only`: can be searched, never returned. `deferred`: not fetched unless selected. `not searchable`: returned, but cannot be searched or sorted by |

## Identifiers

Fields that identify a record. The first of `bibcode`, `scix_id` and `id` with a value identifies a document.

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bibcode` |  | `str` | keyword |  | Document bibliographic code. See https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/actions/bibcode for more information. |
| `id` |  | `str` | keyword |  | A unique identifier for the document, curated by ADS: a string of digits. Queries also accept an int, e.g. Document.id == 12312494. |
| `scix_id` |  | `str` | keyword |  | The SciX identifier of the record. |
| `alternate_bibcode` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Alternate bibcodes of the record. |
| `identifier` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Search by an array of alternative identifiers for a record. May contain alternative bibcodes, DOIs, and/or arXiv identifiers. |
| `doi` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Digital object identifier(s). |
| `arxiv` |  | `str` | text | search-only | Search by arXiv identifier (an alias of identifier). |
| `isbn` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | International Standard Book Number(s). |
| `issn` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | International Standard Serial Number(s). |
| `eid` |  | `str` | keyword |  | Electronic identifier of the paper (equivalent of page number). |
| `all` |  | `str` | text | search-only | Search by author_norm, alternate_title, bibcode, doi, and identifier. |

## Publication

Where and when the document was published.

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | The title of the record (and any other titles it has). |
| `alternate_title` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Alternate title, usually present when the original title is not in English. |
| `abstract` |  | `str` | text |  | The document abstract. |
| `doctype` |  | `str` | keyword |  | Search documents by their type: article, thesis, et cetera. |
| `year` |  | `int` | keyword |  | Year of publication. |
| `pubdate` |  | `date` | keyword |  | Publication date (to month-level granularity only). |
| `date` |  | `datetime` | keyword |  | Publication date, represented by a time format and used for indexing. For example: date == datetime(2015, 7, 1). |
| `pub` |  | `str` | keyword |  | The canonical name of the publication that the record appeared in. |
| `pub_abbrev` |  | `str` | keyword |  | The abbreviated name of the publication. |
| `pub_raw` |  | `str` | text |  | Name of the publisher, but also includes the volume, page, and issue if exists. |
| `publisher` |  | `str` | text |  | Name of the publisher. |
| `bibstem` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Abbreviated name(s) of the journal or publication (e.g., ApJ). |
| `volume` |  | `str` | keyword |  | The journal volume. |
| `issue` |  | `str` | keyword |  | Issue number of the journal that includes the article. |
| `page` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Page number of a record. |
| `page_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | If page_range is present, it gives the difference between the first and last page numbers in the range. |
| `page_range` |  | `str` | keyword | not searchable | The page range of the record. Returned, but not searchable. |
| `series` |  | `str` | text |  | Name of the series, e.g. of a book or of conference proceedings. |
| `thesis` |  | `str` | text |  | Thesis information, such as the degree-granting institution. |
| `editor` |  | `list[str]` | name |  | Editors of the publication. |
| `book_author` |  | `list[str]` | name |  | Authors of the book containing the record (e.g. for a chapter). |
| `comment` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Comments on the record, e.g. from the publisher. |
| `pubnote` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Notes about the publication, e.g. 'Accepted for publication in ApJ'. |
| `copyright` |  | `str` | text |  | The copyright statement. |
| `lang` |  | `str` | keyword | search-only | The language of the main title. Search-only. |

## Authors and affiliations

Per-author fields hold one entry per author, in author order ('-' for none). See also the `authors` collection below.

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `author` |  | `list[str]` | name |  | Author names, 'Lastname, First M', in order. |
| `first_author` |  | `str` | name |  | The first author's name, 'Lastname, First M'. |
| `author_norm` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Author names in the form 'Lastname, F'. |
| `first_author_norm` |  | `str` | keyword |  | The first author's name in the form 'Lastname, F'. |
| `author_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | The number of authors. |
| `aff` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | The raw, provided affiliation field: one string per author. |
| `aff_id` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Curated affiliation identifiers, parsed from the given affiliation string, one entry per author ('-' for none; 'A1; A2' for several). See https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/blog/affils-update. |
| `aff_abbrev` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Abbreviations of the curated affiliations, one entry per author. |
| `aff_canonical` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Canonical names of the curated affiliations, one entry per author. |
| `institution` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Curated institution abbreviations, one entry per author (searched by inst). |
| `affil` |  | `str` | text | search-only | Search all affiliation fields at once: raw strings, canonical names, abbreviations and identifiers. |
| `inst` |  | `str` | text | search-only | Find records that contain a curated (ADS-identified) affiliation or institution, including its child institutions. See also: Document.affiliation. |
| `email` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Search by email addresses for the authors that included them in the article ('-' for none). |
| `orcid` |  | `str` | text | search-only | ORCID identifier, from all possible sources. |
| `orcid_pub` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | ORCIDs supplied by publishers. |
| `orcid_user` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | ORCID claims from users who gave ADS consent to expose their public profile. |
| `orcid_other` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | ORCID claims from users who used the ADS claiming interface. |

## Citations, readership and ranking

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `citation` |  | `list[str]` | keyword | deferred | Bibcodes of the documents citing this one. |
| `citation_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | The number of citations to this document. |
| `citation_count_norm` |  | `float` | keyword |  | Normalised citation count: citations divided by the number of authors. |
| `reference` |  | `list[str]` | keyword | deferred | Bibcodes of the documents this one cites. |
| `reference_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | The number of documents this one cites. |
| `credit` |  | `list[str]` | keyword | deferred | Bibcodes of the documents that mention (credit) this record. |
| `credit_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | The number of documents that mention (credit) this record. |
| `mention` |  | `list[str]` | keyword | deferred | Bibcodes of the records (e.g. software) this document mentions. |
| `mention_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | The number of records (e.g. software) this document mentions. |
| `read_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | The number of times the record has been viewed within a 90 day window. |
| `cite_read_boost` |  | `float` | keyword |  | The normalized boost factor. |
| `classic_factor` |  | `int` | keyword |  | A classic prestige score, designed to more highly rank papers that are relevant and popular now. |
| `score` |  | `float` | keyword |  | The closeness of the document to the query match (Solr's relevance score for the query that returned it; not an index field). |

## Subjects and classification

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | An array of normalized and non-normalized keyword values associated with the record. |
| `keyword_norm` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Keywords normalised to a controlled vocabulary. |
| `keyword_schema` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | The vocabulary each keyword in keyword comes from. |
| `arxiv_class` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | The arXiv classes a document was submitted to. |
| `uat_id` |  | `list[int]` | keyword |  | Unified Astronomy Thesaurus concept numbers of the record. See also: Document.uat_concepts. |
| `uat` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Unified Astronomy Thesaurus (UAT) concepts assigned to the record, as text (Document.uat_concepts is the relation to UATConcept). |
| `planetary_feature_id` |  | `list[int]` | keyword |  | Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature feature ids of the planetary features in the record. See also: Document.planetary_features. |
| `planetary_feature` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Planetary features mentioned in the record, as text (Document.planetary_features is the relation to PlanetaryFeature). |
| `gpn` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Planetary features named in the record, from the Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature. |
| `gpn_id` |  | `list[int]` | keyword |  | Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature identifiers of those features. |
| `facility` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Facilities declared in a record, based on a controlled list by AAS journals. |
| `database` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | The database(s) the document resides in (e.g., astronomy or physics). |
| `collection` |  | `str` | text | search-only | Search by collection (an alias of database), e.g. 'astronomy'. |
| `bibgroup` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Records by bibliographic groups, curated by staff outside of ADS. |
| `property` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | An array of miscellaneous flags associated with a record. Examples include: refereed, notrefereed, article, nonarticle, ads_openaccess, eprint_openaccess, pub_openaccess, openaccess, ocrabstract. |
| `nedid` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | List of NED IDs for a record. |
| `nedtype` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Keywords used to describe the NED type (e.g., galaxy, star). |
| `simbid` |  | `list[int]` | keyword |  | List of SIMBAD IDs within a document. This field has privacy restrictions. |
| `simbtype` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Keywords used to describe the SIMBAD type. |
| `vizier` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Keywords, 'subject' tags from Vizier. |

## Full text and data

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `abs` |  | `str` | text | search-only | Search for a word or phrase in abstract, title, and keywords. |
| `full` |  | `str` | text | search-only | Search by title, abstract, body, keyword, and ack. |
| `body` |  | `str` | text | deferred | The full text, where ADS has it. Search it with body == '...'. |
| `ack` |  | `str` | text | deferred | The acknowledgements extracted from the full text. |
| `caption` |  | `list[str]` | text | deferred | Figure and table captions extracted from the full text. |
| `data` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Related data sources. For example: data == 'CDS' will return records that have CDS data. |
| `data_count` |  | `int` | keyword |  | The number of related data sources. |
| `esources` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | Types of electronic sources available for a record (e.g., pub_html, eprint_pdf). |
| `links_data` |  | `list[str]` | keyword | not searchable | Information on what linked documents are available (JSON strings). Returned, but not searchable. |
| `has` |  | `list[str]` | keyword |  | The names of the fields this record has values for; e.g. has == 'body' finds records with full text. |

## Funding

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `grant` |  | `list[str]` | text |  | Search by grant identifiers and grant agencies. |
| `grant_agencies` |  | `str` | text | search-only | A field with just the grant agencies name (e.g., NASA). Not in the published index schema. |

## Record keeping

| Field | Solr name | Type | Match | Notes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entry_date` |  | `datetime` | keyword |  | Creation date of the ADS record. Note that this can be used like Document.entry_date &gt;= days_ago(7). |
| `indexstamp` |  | `datetime` | keyword |  | Datetime when the document was last indexed by the ADS Solr service. |

## Relations

Relations link a document to records of other models. Search through them (`Document.journal.title == ...`, `Document.affiliation.any(...)`); on a result they give the related objects.

| Relation | Related model | Through | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `journal` | `Journal` | `bibstem` → `abbreviation` | The journal the document appeared in, from the journal part of its bibcode (None if unknown). |
| `affiliation` | `Affiliation` | `aff_id` → `id` | The curated affiliations, one entry per author: None, an Affiliation, or a tuple of them (from aff_id; ids missing from the local affiliation data are skipped). Use scixplorer.utils.flatten() to scan them. |
| `uat_concepts` | `UATConcept` | `uat_id` → `id` | The Unified Astronomy Thesaurus concepts of the document (from uat_id; unknown ids are skipped, and a document without any gives an empty list). Needs data.refresh('uat') once. |
| `planetary_features` | `PlanetaryFeature` | `planetary_feature_id` → `id` | The planetary features named in the document (from planetary_feature_id; unknown ids are skipped, and a document without any gives an empty list). Needs data.refresh('planetary_features') once. |

## Collections

| Collection | Records | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `authors` | `Author` | The authors, in order, as Author objects combining each author's name, affiliations, email and ORCID. Search with Document.authors.any(...) / .all(...) (each about one author) or by position: Document.authors[0].orcid == '...'. |
